_comment: A foot block gives back the turn it made onto riders inside its ranks only while that brings its ranks nearer square, never further off (#1868). A 48-man Infantry block (8 files by 6 ranks) stands on Hold facing east, and a brittle 12-horse Cavalry troop (morale 3) charges it from the south. On the clip seed the block first snaps round toward the riders, a turn the men make in place, so its ranks stand about 66 degrees off its heading (tick 618). The riders then ride into its ranks, and each small re-face onto them is folded into the formation, turning the heading back the other way and past the ranks: by tick 900, still in contact, the heading stands 22.2 degrees beyond them on the other side. The troop breaks by tick 760 and the block is last in contact at tick 910. Giving back every turn it made onto the riders, as main did before #1868, would carry the ranks on round to the 67-degree turn the block made in place. A turn is given back only while it brings the ranks nearer square, so the block gives back the 22.2 degrees and stops on square (tick 1012): 0.2 degrees at tick 1100. Perturbed seeds 1 to 3 read 0.0, 0.1 and 24.5 at tick 1100; on seed 3 the fight lasts to tick 1008 and the squaring has not finished by tick 1100; seed 4 plays as on main. The tick-1100 claim's 2-degree tolerance covers the dump's rounding, which keeps a square grid from reading exactly 0 (up to about 0.4 degrees). The tick-900 check (22 +/- 5 degrees: the riders have carried the heading past the ranks before the block is clear) and the tick-8 position, tick-360 Hold, tick-620 FIGHTING and tick-760 ROUTING checks are setup, and tick 1100 still reads Hold, so no order squared the ranks. The clip ends at tick 1100, before the troop rallies, since a rallying troop's re-form is not what this clip shows. Static camera. Deterministic (scenario + seed + scripted input). Figures measured with full state dumps every 2 ticks on 3c442b07, where a cavalry troop in contact wheels onto its enemy at a bounded rate (#1806), against main aeb67079; there the riders brought the ranks back square to the heading before the block was clear (2.3 degrees at tick 900), and the tick-900 check read 0 +/- 5.
